enrichment.headline: Ratifies Berkeley Lab agreement to advise OUSD on classroom air quality and ventilation at no cash cost
enrichment.summary: The district has a short research agreement with the University of California, on behalf of Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, as it prepares to reopen classrooms. The lab will review guidance on reducing the spread of airborne virus particles and help pick indoor air quality monitors, as the district considers whether its classroom heating and ventilation systems are adequate. The district pays $0.00 in cash and gives $1,350.00 in in-kind (non-cash) support; the university contributes $10,000.00 through its U.S. Department of Energy contract. enrichment.headline: Moves $7,795 at Castlemont High to pay Oakland Kids First for student internship stipends
enrichment.summary: Castlemont High School asked to move $7,795 within its 2020-21 Measure N budget. The money comes from its Supplies & Materials line, where nothing has been spent so far this year, and goes to Consultant Contracts so that Oakland Kids First can provide stipends for school-year and summer student internships. This is a transfer of money the school already has, not new funding.

items.group: Measure N Commission - February 2, 2021 Jason Gumataotao, Chairperson

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Moves $13,125 at Skyline High from travel and substitute budgets to teacher collaboration stipends
enrichment.summary: Skyline High School asked to move $13,125 within its 2020-21 Measure N budget. The money comes from transportation, teacher substitute and AC Transit/BART ticket lines that are not needed this year because travel, field trips and conferences are not happening. It goes to stipends for teachers on extended contracts to collaborate and take part in training. This is a transfer of money the school already has, not new funding.

enrichment.summary: The Measure N commission recommends that Rudsdale Continuation and Newcomer Schools be allowed to carry its unspent 2019-20 Measure N fund balance into the next year, along with its spending plan.
